programme.title: I was a king - Tomasz Frankowski
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The hero of the next episode is Tomasz Frankowski. The striker won the title of top scorer in the Ekstraklasa four times and won the Polish championship five times with Wisła Kraków. In total, he scored 168 goals in the league. Frankowski is a symbol of the golden era of the Krakow club. We will also see his performances in Jagiellonia Białystok. The authors also return to the famous decision to omit him from the World Cup squad. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Pogoń Szczecin – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In recent years, the Port team came close to winning the Polish Cup and winning the Ekstraklasa podium. Robert Kolendowicz, Pogoń's coach, assures that the failures have not hampered the team. In his opinion, the Pride of Pomerania is much more hungry for success than its most dangerous rivals in the country. This is reflected in the movements of Szczecin's players on the transfer market. In the ongoing window, the Navy and Burgundy squad was strengthened by, among others: midfielder José Pozo from Śląsk and Paul Mukairu - former winger of FC Copenhagen. From Pogoń's perspective, however, the key factor may be the fact that despite interest from foreign clubs, Efthymios Koulouris, who scored 28 goals in the last Ekstraklasa season, will not leave the team. In the second round of the 2025/26 campaign, Portowcy will be tested by Motor Lublin. The ambitions of the Yellow-White-Blue are much higher than their seventh place at the end of the previous competition. Motor, on the other hand, wants to show that he has established himself among the elite and poses a real threat to the league leaders. We'll see if he will make a comeback from the match from November last year, when he defeated Pogoń 4:2

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lechia Gdańsk – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: The first matches of Lech Poznań this season could not fill the fans of the Polish champion with optimism. Kolejorz lost the national Super Cup match against Legia 1:2, and at the inauguration of the Ekstraklasa it was defeated 1:4 by Cracovia. However, the Poznań team rose from its knees and won against Icelandic Breidablik 7:1 in the Champions League qualifiers. Lech will try to transfer the form from this match to the league pitch and defeat Lechia Gdańsk

programme.title: North USA: the wild frontier
programme.desc: The northern areas of the USA are known for extreme weather phenomena. They also provide numerous wildlife habitats. However, the proximity to the Canadian border poses many threats to the animals living in this region... Canada. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – In a Hurry | E04

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – It's a trap! | E05
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E06
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. Kellie and Henri receive disturbing news that forces them to give up their search for gold. The companions rush to protect the premises of their lease from uninvited guests. Unexpected adversities mean that a team may fail to achieve its goal. Vern and Leon decide to start searching for a new deposit. While on the road, newcomer Lindsay makes a once-in-a-lifetime discovery. Meanwhile, on the hill, the Clarks notice a quartz deposit, which convinces them that they are one step away from a gold mine. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E07
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. There are only two weeks left until the end of the season. Kellie and Henri are forced to change their plans in the face of equipment failure and a shocking crime. Vern and Leon are desperately searching for a new land rich in ore that they can regain with Goldzilla's help. They unexpectedly make a discovery thanks to which they can gain a real fortune. Time is running out and the Clarks are starting to lose hope that they will be able to end the season on a positive note. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E08
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. Vern and Leon must collect 600 ounces, or just over 17 kilograms, of the precious metal before the end of the season. To achieve this, the partners risk a lot and expect maximum effort from their people. After two huge setbacks, Kellie and Henri can no longer afford to make any mistakes if they are to reach their goal of 50 ounces. The Clarks are also desperately fighting for every gram of gold. In their struggles, they do not even hesitate to risk their lives. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Snow creatures
programme.desc: Animals must have a variety of tactics prepared to survive in one of the coldest places on our planet. From finding a convenient place to hunt to a shelter where they can raise their offspring. Nature film presenter Liz Bonnin will show viewers how animals cope in such difficult conditions... Great Britain. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Scottish pines
programme.desc: The Scots pine is one of the symbols of Scotland. This species of tree is now planted in the highlands there as part of wildlife restoration projects. This may be their return after a long time, because this is where they grew before... Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Animals: Masters of Survival 2 – Masters of Disguise | S02E05
programme.desc: Many animal species have developed unique survival skills through evolution. Viewers will meet twenty of their representatives in various survival categories... Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Underwater City – Summer | S01E02
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef ecosystem is a unique and biologically diverse area, one of the largest structures of this type in the world. Like a bustling city, the reef harbors many distinct neighborhoods inhabited by coral and other animals, including lagoons, sandy islands and coastal rainforests. Each of these places has a unique rhythm of life, depending on the tides and times of day, as well as the variability of the seasons. The summer season is approaching. Starfish, coral lovers, organize a hunt. Huge sea snails try to defend themselves against predators. At midnight, reef sharks start hunting. Thanks to its unique camouflage ability, the parrotfish can survive the night. Australia. 2024. nature series

programme.title: Off the coast of Australia – Cold South | E02
programme.desc: Viewers can see up close the shape-shifting cuttlefish and huge blue whales that inhabit Australia's southern coast. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Summer | E04
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Summer is a time of plenty for most animals - but not for polar bears. These predators cannot hunt seals until the sea freezes over. They are getting hungrier every day. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Cheetahs on a hot plain | E03
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. A slender build, black spots on light fur, hyperventilation and regular licking to evaporate saliva - these are the cheetah's most effective tricks to help it survive in high temperatures. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Ireland: Crazy Year – Winter | E04
programme.desc: Ireland located on the islands will be presented. From its wild coastlines, mountains and forests to farms, cities and towns. In each episode we will see how Ireland changes throughout the seasons. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Giants – Crocodiles | E03
programme.desc: Dan O'Neill sets off to Kenya on a mission to find, film and measure the largest elephants on the planet. Dan O'Neill wants to find, film and measure the largest living crocodiles; he joins a local guide in hopes of tracking down the giant male. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E08
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. In the episode, the creators will talk about the mudslide that ruined the city of Montecito in California. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Leopards | E02
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Pacific – Shallows | S01E02
programme.desc: The creators of the program talk about the Pacific Ocean, the largest ocean in the world, covering an area of ​​170 million square kilometers. Viewers will have the opportunity to look at the coral reef and see the local beaches and capes. They will also learn about the inhabitants of water, from crabs and sea cows to the more predatory rulers of the ocean. Viewers go to the shallow waters of the Pacific and watch the exploits of the dolphins living there. Then they visit the largest coral reef in the world and take part in an animal gathering in which future mother turtles also participate. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Rivers | S01E03
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Viewers will learn about the ecosystems that have developed in waterways in various parts of the world - from volcanic rivers in eastern Russia to geothermal streams in Florida. Filmmakers observe, among others: the activity of beavers, which gives a unique character to river landscapes, as well as the winter spa of manatees. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E09
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. A bomb cyclone, an extremely rare and violent atmospheric phenomenon, suddenly developed in northeastern America, causing a huge pileup on a highway and terrorizing the passengers of a cruise ship battered by huge waves. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Minister of Defense
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

A Wild Year on Earth: July-August – A Time of Migration (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep4 «A Wild Year on Earth»…Witness some of the planet's most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska | Charts the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: Reef Wrecks: Roatan (S1E4). Documentary about nature. USA, Canada, 2016. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep4 «Reef Wrecks»…This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island | This show takes the viewer on an underwater journey of discovery to explore the hidden world of sunken wrecks. The ocean floor is littered with centuries' worth of vessels that met an unfortunate end and were dragged to the depths. However, over many years, these wrecks have been transformed into artificial reefs that provide shelter and home to a multitude of plant and animal marine life. Each episode focuses on different locations such as the unique collection of wrecks found around the small Caribbean island of Bonaire; the vessels that were deliberately scuppered off the coast of Roatan; the wrecks around the coast of the Yucatan peninsula that provide a special environment for sweepers, groupers and the whale shark to thirve; and the ruined planes and ships surrounding New Providence in the Bahamas that were used in Hollywood movies | Director: Andrew Killawee

programme.title: The Living Beach: Hawaii (S1E4). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2016. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep4 «The Living Beach»…Throughout the Hawaiian Islands, natural forces of creation and destruction can be observed in real-time as they work to shape the living beach. These beaches are forged inside active volcanoes: every bit of land exists here because of these red-hot furnaces | When we think of a beach, we often think of a carefree place where we can relax and do nothing. Yet for the natural world, the opposite is true – this documentary series shows us how nature is constantly at work on the world's beaches. Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: Shadowlands: Bound By Blood (S1E1). Documentary about nature. New Zealand, 2021. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2021 г. Год: 2021. Страна: Naujoji Zelandija. Год: 2021. S1, Ep1 «Shadowlands»…The southwest corner of New Zealand's South Island is hemmed in by giant mountains and the rough Pacific Ocean. Rare penguins are locked in a daily game of cat and mouse with giant New Zealand sea lions. The sea lions also live in a tumultuous world, where pups must battle the elements to survive | Life in the southwest corner of our planet is challenging, but some creatures made it their home. We explore how these animals survive and thrive in the extremely harsh conditions that include terrible winds and icy-cold air and water. Each species has its unique and impressive ways to stay alive, from dolphins and sea lions to spider crabs, penguins and more | Director: Siddharth Nambiar, Carolyn Dodd | Cast: Te Kohe Tuhaka

Travelling to coastlines across the globe including Australia, Mexico and Florida, we are told how the shores have been created over time, we also learn about the diverse ecosystems and the species that call the beach home. We are shown the human impact on the beaches and the efforts being made to protect them. Narrated by Tish Iceton | Director: Josh MacDonald, Matt Trecartin | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.desc: Những vận may lớn nhất thế giới thường xuất hiện ở những nơi khó ngờ nhất. Từ một quả trứng Faberge được tìm thấy ở một khu chợ trời khiêm tốn, hay thậm chí là một viên sapphire ở sân sau có giá trị tiền chuộc của một vị vua.

programme.title: ALONE S11 EP10
programme.desc: Khi dòng sông cuối cùng bắt đầu đóng băng, những người sống sót còn lại phải vật lộn với việc mất đi ánh sáng ban ngày. Dây bẫy của một người tham gia bị kẻ săn mồi rình rập; người khác nghĩ ra kế hoạch đánh bại kẻ thù.

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S4 EP38
programme.desc: 100 năm trước, một số món ăn chính của Bữa tối Lễ Tạ ơn đã không xuất hiện...cho đến khi một số thương hiệu mang tính biểu tượng sử dụng tiến bộ công nghệ để phát minh lại món gà tây, nhân nhồi, nước sốt nam việt quất, bánh bí ngô và hơn thế nữa.

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: THỢ SĂN MÁU: SỰ TRỖI DẬY CỦA QUÁI VẬT LAI - BLOOD HUNTERS: RISE OF THE HYBRI
programme.desc: Gabriella bị thôi thúc bởi sự trả thù sau khi một con quái vật lai tàn sát gia đình cô. Trong nhiệm vụ của mình, cô gia nhập một đội Thợ săn máu và họ cùng nhau tiến hành cuộc chiến chống lại các lãnh chúa tàn nhẫn của thế giới ngầm, gây ra một cuộc đối đầu tàn khốc.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.
